name: cerebrium
description: Durable cross-session memory for coding agents, served by a Cerebrium host over the tailnet

kernel_url.title: Cerebrium host URL
kernel_url.description: The host kernel, as tcp://host:port (for example tcp://100.92.157.103:7433).

token_file.title: Token file
token_file.description: A file readable only by you (mode 600) holding this machine's principal token, issued on the host with `cerebrium-service token issue`. Only the path is stored.
